_meta.description: Initial seed primitives for PHOTO_EDITORIAL family. Decomposed from DP and Art.txt reference prompts. Hand-curated, not auto-extracted. All entries tagged family=photo_editorial.
_meta.loaded_by: core/prompt_alchemy.py at import time; merged into PRIMITIVES dict.

kit_of_parts_breakdown.name: Kit-of-Parts Breakdown
kit_of_parts_breakdown.prompt_snippet: collage-like breakdown of subject, central medium-length shot with multiple detailed close-up inset panels arranged within same frame, each inset bordered by thin white line, white target reticle symbol centered within each inset, detailed inspection aesthetic

stacked_triptych_fragments.name: Stacked Triptych Fragments
stacked_triptych_fragments.prompt_snippet: subject face cropped into three vertically-stacked sections (top: eye, middle: nose, bottom: mouth), each section displayed in its own vertically aligned object/screen, centered composition
stacked_triptych_fragments.negative: single frame, unified face, symmetrical halves

floating_dominant_subject.name: Floating Dominant Subject
floating_dominant_subject.prompt_snippet: large floating photograph of subject dominating open space, fragments of the image slowly falling like dust, symbolic composition

crouch_on_platform.name: Crouch on Platform
crouch_on_platform.prompt_snippet: subject crouches powerfully center frame, one knee raised, one hand flat on the ground, positioned on a single perfectly square intensely bright illuminated platform

vertical_stacked_figures.name: Vertical Stacked Figures
vertical_stacked_figures.prompt_snippet: three overlapping figures in vertical layered composition, foremost figure sharply illuminated and dominating the scene, the others emerging partially from shadows behind and above, cascading stacked structure, solemn and theatrical arrangement
vertical_stacked_figures.negative: horizontal arrangement, equal lighting, isolated figures

centered_surreal_object.name: Centered Surreal Object
centered_surreal_object.prompt_snippet: single object centered on surreal minimalist landscape, clear sky, strict symmetrical framing, object occupies center third of frame

knitted_portrait.name: Knitted Portrait
knitted_portrait.prompt_snippet: close up horizontally oriented portrait of subject rendered as knitted fabric, floating against a solid background, subject fills frame
knitted_portrait.negative: full scene, landscape orientation, realistic skin

layered_collage_portrait.name: Layered Collage Portrait
layered_collage_portrait.prompt_snippet: layered collage art, subject profile shot with integrated textures as overlays, mixed-media composition, sophisticated layering

hard_on_camera_flash.name: Hard On-Camera Flash
hard_on_camera_flash.prompt_snippet: hard on-camera flash photography, high-contrast sharp shadows cast behind subject on back wall, overexposed highlights, direct frontal flash
hard_on_camera_flash.negative: soft lighting, diffused, natural light, golden hour

single_source_underlighting.name: Single-Source Underlighting
single_source_underlighting.prompt_snippet: single source extreme underlighting from below the subject, dramatic upward shadows on face and body, mysterious futuristic editorial mood

caravaggio_chiaroscuro.name: Caravaggio Chiaroscuro
caravaggio_chiaroscuro.prompt_snippet: strong single directional light source, deep black shadows, sculptural illumination of subject, rich chiaroscuro, baroque contrast, painterly shadow falloff
caravaggio_chiaroscuro.negative: flat lighting, ambient, high-key, soft shadows

midnight_neon_ambient.name: Midnight Neon Ambient
midnight_neon_ambient.prompt_snippet: deep midnight blue neon ambient lighting along edges, warm amber accent from single vintage lamp, cool-vs-warm dual temperature contrast, atmospheric depth

studio_controlled_cinematic.name: Studio Controlled Cinematic
studio_controlled_cinematic.prompt_snippet: soft overhead key light with faint front fill, controlled shadows, slight specular highlights on reflective surfaces, clean studio lighting

point_and_shoot_flash.name: Point-and-Shoot Flash
point_and_shoot_flash.prompt_snippet: point-and-shoot flash photograph aesthetic, consumer-grade 35mm compact camera look, slight color cast, authentic candid quality
point_and_shoot_flash.negative: professional digital, medium format, shallow DOF

crt_monochrome_signal.name: CRT Monochrome Signal
crt_monochrome_signal.prompt_snippet: red monochrome CRT signal, visible scanlines, slight distortion, plastic casing wear, dust on screen, subtle chromatic aberration, CRT glass reflection
crt_monochrome_signal.negative: sharp digital, clean LCD, color video

arri_alexa_studio.name: ARRI Alexa 35 Studio
arri_alexa_studio.prompt_snippet: shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with Zeiss Ultra Prime 50mm lens at f/4, subtle film grain, soft halation, slight chromatic aberration, no oversharpening, cinematic material realism

kodak_vision3_500t.name: Kodak Vision3 500T Film
kodak_vision3_500t.prompt_snippet: shot on 35mm motion picture film, Kodak Vision3 500T, 50mm lens, subtle halation and light bloom, high gloss specular highlights where appropriate

fujifilm_velvia_50.name: Fujifilm Velvia 50
fujifilm_velvia_50.prompt_snippet: shot on Fujifilm Velvia 50 film, saturated color reproduction, fine grain, rich tonal depth, vintage slide film aesthetic

kintsugi_porcelain_skin.name: Kintsugi Porcelain Skin
kintsugi_porcelain_skin.prompt_snippet: porcelain pale skin with golden kintsugi veins as real textured cracks filled with warm matte gold along temples, cheekbones and fingers, luminous fracture aesthetic
kintsugi_porcelain_skin.negative: smooth unbroken skin, painted-on gold, digital overlay

porcelain_miniature.name: Porcelain Miniature
porcelain_miniature.prompt_snippet: smooth porcelain skin, glossy reflective surface, miniature scale, pale white tone, reflective highlights, ultra-smooth ceramic finish
porcelain_miniature.negative: rough texture, matte, full-size, skin pores

knitted_fabric_surface.name: Knitted Fabric Surface
knitted_fabric_surface.prompt_snippet: rendered as knitted fabric, visible yarn weave, textile texture, handcrafted wool or cotton quality, tactile surface
knitted_fabric_surface.negative: smooth skin, photographic subject, digital render

silk_embroidery_overlay.name: Silk Embroidery Overlay
silk_embroidery_overlay.prompt_snippet: integrated textures of vintage Chinese silk embroidery layered onto surface, thread detail visible, rich textile pattern
silk_embroidery_overlay.negative: plain fabric, printed graphic, digital texture

gold_leaf_kintsugi_overlay.name: Gold Leaf Kintsugi Overlay
gold_leaf_kintsugi_overlay.prompt_snippet: gold leaf kintsugi cracks across the face, delicate metallic overlay, thin veins of warm gold, preserved imperfection aesthetic
gold_leaf_kintsugi_overlay.negative: painted gold, shiny plastic, unbroken surface

editorial_void_platform.name: Editorial Void Platform
editorial_void_platform.prompt_snippet: vast pitch-black void background, single perfectly square intensely bright illuminated platform at center, strong negative space, dramatic shadow masking
editorial_void_platform.negative: busy background, any environment, ambient light elsewhere

voyeuristic_contained_space.name: Voyeuristic Contained Space
voyeuristic_contained_space.prompt_snippet: 3D-rendered transparent glass box revealing intimate interior scene, slight lens condensation on glass walls, voyeuristic composition peering in from outside
voyeuristic_contained_space.negative: open environment, no containment, direct framing

surreal_minimal_landscape.name: Surreal Minimal Landscape
surreal_minimal_landscape.prompt_snippet: clear blue sky above a small grassy hill, vast minimalist landscape, single subject perched atop, dreamlike stillness

symbolic_fragment_scene.name: Symbolic Fragment Scene
symbolic_fragment_scene.prompt_snippet: dramatic lighting reveals large floating object in open space, fragments slowly falling like dust, symbolic fine-art composition, quiet ominous energy
symbolic_fragment_scene.negative: intact objects, chaotic motion, bright daylight

creative_workspace_nocturne.name: Creative Workspace Nocturne
creative_workspace_nocturne.prompt_snippet: intimate midnight creative workspace, walls layered with reference prints pinned chaotically, string connections between references, scattered materials on desk, late-night intensity
creative_workspace_nocturne.negative: clean minimalist studio, empty desk, daylight

baroque_sacred_chamber.name: Baroque Sacred Chamber
baroque_sacred_chamber.prompt_snippet: deep black baroque background, expressive drapery, sculptural surfaces, monumental vertical composition, sacred and ominous atmosphere

global_fusion_texture.name: Global Fusion Texture
global_fusion_texture.prompt_snippet: global-fusion aesthetic, combining textile embroidery, architectural blueprints, gold leaf accents, ink wash background, sophisticated and rich layered texture

scanline_chromatic_aberration.name: Scanlines + Chromatic Aberration
scanline_chromatic_aberration.prompt_snippet: visible scanlines across image, subtle RGB chromatic aberration along high-contrast edges, analog video degradation aesthetic
scanline_chromatic_aberration.negative: clean digital, sharp modern, no artifacts
